title: Oxford Nanopore Technologies 16S Barcoding NGS Prep
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the provided link and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware definition files with a .json extension, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the OT App's Protocol tab, upload the protocol script file that has a .py extension.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place all labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the supplied deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate each piece of labware, tip rack, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if required.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to execute the protocol.
